title.narrative: Apoyo al Sector Transporte de Hait II
Support for Transport Sector in Haiti II

description.narrative: El objetivo general de esta operacin es contribuir a la recuperacin de la infraestructura vial en Hait, a fin de restablecer unas condiciones operativas adecuadas y sostenibles de Hait; todo ello con el propsito de incentivar la prestacin de servicios de transporte continuos, competitivos y seguros, y contribuir as a la reactivacin econmica y la mejora de la calidad de vida de la poblacin.

The objective of this operation is to contribute to the recovery of the road infrastructure in Haiti, in order to restore a few operative suitable and sustainable conditions in an important part of the road network in Haiti; all this with the intention of encouraging the services of transportation to be continuos, competitive and safe; contributing in this way to the economic recuperation and the progress of the quality of life of the population.
